Navori Flickerblade

2650 goldFinished item

A crit item with attack speed whose attacks lower the remaining cooldowns of your basic abilities by 15%.

Stats

  • 40% Attack Speed
  • 25% Critical Strike Chance
  • 4% Move Speed

What it does

Transcendence: Attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 15% of their remaining cooldown.

When to buy it

Buy it on attack-speed champions whose basic abilities are a big part of their damage or safety.

Good on

Tristana Xayah Sivir Samira

Builds from

Dagger Zeal

In our champion builds

None of our current builds use it.
